records.title: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship
records.degree_levels: Undergraduate, Graduate, Japanese Language Institute, College of Technology, Specialized Training College
records.eligibility_summary: Privately-financed international students with excellent academic and character records; enrolled or about to enroll in a Japanese educational institution; facing financial difficulties; income criteria apply (supporter's annual income <5 million yen).

records.eligibility_summary: Open to international fee-paying applicants domiciled in Bangladesh, Pakistan or Sri Lanka who must hold a conditional or unconditional offer for a full-time, on-campus master's course at Manchester starting September 2027 and submit the online scholarship application form by 25 April 2027. Applicants must be self-funded and must have taken their bachelor's degree within South Asia.

records.title: Rotary Peace Fellowship
records.deadline_label: Submit your application between February and 15 May
records.eligibility_summary: Dedicated leaders with work experience in peace and development who are committed to community and international service. Candidates must not be pursuing doctoral study, and are barred if they are a spouse, lineal descendant, or close blood relative of a current Rotary member, a former Rotary member within 36 months, or a recent Rotary Peace Fellow or Global Grant Scholarship recipient.

records.title: Umeå University Scholarship for International Students
records.deadline_label: 4 March (23:59 CET): Deadline to register interest for a scholarship
records.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who have applied for a full Umeå University bachelor's or master's programme, completed the application by the 15 January deadline, paid the application fee by 2 February, and have a Umeå University programme as priority 1 on University Admissions. Second-year master's students and registered students who have paid the spring semester tuition fee may also register interest.

records.title: UCAS Chinese Government Scholarship (University of Chinese Academy of Sciences)
records.awarding_body: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) & China Scholarship Council (CSC)
records.eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid passport who are friendly to China, abide by Chinese law and UCAS rules, and are proficient in English or Mandarin. Master's applicants need a qualification equivalent to a Chinese bachelor's degree and must be 35 or under; PhD applicants need a qualification equivalent to a Chinese master's degree and must be 40 or under. Applicants must not hold any other sponsorship at the time of application or during the scholarship, and must study full time at the research institute where they are enrolled.

records.title: Camoes, I.P. Portuguese Language and Culture Scholarships
records.awarding_body: Camões - Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Portugal)
records.deadline_label: applications are open from 5 to 18 May 2026 (until 5 p.m., Lisbon time)
records.eligibility_summary: Course scholarships are aimed at 'foreign students and Portuguese citizens living abroad who wish to improve their language skills'. The Fernão Mendes Pinto Programme is for foreign and Portuguese students who are graduates or in their final year of undergraduate study and are involved in scientific or professional training projects in Portuguese as a Foreign Language. The Research Programme is for teachers and researchers, foreign or Portuguese living abroad, undertaking specialisation studies including master's and PhD programmes at Portuguese universities.

records.title: DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students
records.deadline_label: No scholarship deadline is published. The official page states the applicant is 'automatically considered' on applying as a non-EU student to DCU and is told if qualified 'when we contact you to advise if your application to study at DCU has been successf
records.eligibility_summary: Open to non-EU nationals applying to a listed undergraduate or postgraduate programme at Dublin City University. Consideration for the scholarship is automatic on application; no separate scholarship application exists.

records.title: UNESCO/Poland Co-Sponsored Fellowships in Engineering
records.deadline_label: by Monday 26 May 2025, Midnight Paris time at the latest
records.eligibility_summary: Nationals of the invited Member States listed in Annex II (57 states in the 2025 edition) who hold a bachelor's, master's or PhD degree and are nominated by their own National Commission for UNESCO. Because UNESCO is intergovernmental, individual applications are not accepted: the National Commission selects and transmits the application to UNESCO Paris. Specific qualifications per field of research are set in Annex III, and some fields are restricted to particular regions.

records.title: Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Promotionsförderung für Ausländer:innen (FES doctoral scholarship for international doctoral candidates)
records.deadline_label: No fixed calendar deadline is published. The programme page states the right time to apply is up to about two years before submission of the dissertation ('bis circa zwei Jahre vor Abgabe der Dissertation'), and the application page directs applicants to the individual scholarship programme for the deadlines. The online application form for Promotionsförderung für Ausländer:innen is published and open.
records.eligibility_summary: Doctoral candidates from abroad admitted to a German higher education institution, with very good German skills (B2 accepted even without certificate), socio-political engagement, identification with the values of social democracy, an above-average and fast degree result, and a research project making a significant contribution to research; all disciplines except medicine.
